name: sandbox_create
description: Create an isolated Railway preview sandbox from a local workspace project and return its Matrix-owned live preview URL. Use this for running or showing user apps, never the user's main machine. Runtime packages are detected; packages? can override. args: root, start_command, port, install_command?, ttl_seconds?, packages?, env?

name: sandbox_list
description: List your active Railway preview sandboxes and their Matrix-owned URLs.

name: sandbox_exec
description: Run a command inside one of your preview sandboxes and return its real stdout, stderr, exit code, and timeout state. args: id, command, timeout_seconds?

name: sandbox_sync
description: Sync the current files from a local workspace project into an existing preview sandbox. Restart the app with sandbox_exec if its framework does not reload changes. args: id, root

name: sandbox_destroy
description: Destroy one of your Railway preview sandboxes immediately. args: id
